## Completion and escalation

Done means the complete lesson is installed, the usual executable is built,
named checks pass, and the user has a copyable launch command. Visual acceptance
remains for the user. Report material numerical or UI limits honestly.

Continue through routine implementation choices. If a missing decision changes
mathematical meaning or requires an out-of-scope shared architecture change,
identify the exact issue, propose the smallest resolution, and complete
independent authorized work. Do not improvise a new mathematical convention.

Final response: result, launch command, visual test, validation and limitations.
No commit, push, new agent or image. Continue to another lesson only when the
user has explicitly authorized a bounded batch assignment.
